name: MarketOps TinyFish Research Lite

description: TinyFish Search/Fetch for evidence-first public research; paid browser and monitoring operations are restricted in this trial connector.

examples_en: Find official public websites for sports venues in Devon with sources.
Read these three public pages and extract venue type with citations.
